name: Mezuri ~Aa, Densetsu no Ningyo o Motomete~
original_name: 女づり ～あぁ、伝説の人魚を求めて～
source:
Main character buys a book at a secondhand bookstore. It dwelled on contemporary mermaid creatures and ways to capture them. From that day he starts to implement his mermaid capture plan.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-december-2000-never7-end-of.html]vndbreview[/url]]
